system.description: Blowout: Make an attack with the cannons against the target spacecraft. On a success spend a Stress to blow a hole in the hull of the ship. The target takes d8 + 6 damage and becomes Vulnerable.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
